AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

At casting name up to three actually perceived willing creatures within range, optionally yourself, as recognized passers for this cast. This list cannot change later, grants no allegiance/identity credential and is not selected from hidden membership. The following three explicitly NEW constituent spells form one rank-six cast and shared concentration, rather than free castings of Arcane Lock, Fog Cloud or Warning Ward from the catalog.

CLOSURE WARD: choose up to three actual nonliving closed doors/lids/gates entirely within the area and visible to the caster at resolution. No suitable closures simply means no closure targets; the other two constituents still form. Each selected closure is magically secured. A recognized passer can open/close it normally if the underlying physical locks/permissions also allow that act. Another creature can use an Action for STR (Athletics) or, with actual suitable trained thieves' tools, the appropriate DEX tool task against the original spell DC. Success/Critical Success permits that one opening without removing the ward; failure spends the Action, and a new actual forced-opening effort can try again as this explicit repeated physical-task permission. Ordinary locks remain their distinct actual Action/DC15 procedure; defeating the magic alone does not undo them. The ward does not close an open occupied door, crush a body, increase object HP, repair damage or create a door in empty space. Moving/destroying the real closure outside the field ends only its ward participation.

VEIL WARD: the operative field heavily obscures normal vision through its interior for unrecognized observers. Recognized passers see through this specific veil using ordinary sight, not through actual darkness, smoke, Hidden creatures or walls. This is a NEW magical visual veil, not physical fog or an illusory depicted scene. A genuinely applicable reviewed sight source can work only within its actual scope. True Seeing remains pending in the authored index; its older proposal is comparison evidence and grants no accepted bypass here. The veil creates no physical cover, removes no known location and adds no separate Invisible condition. Entering/leaving does not preserve a benefit beyond the live field or turn an unrecognized observer into a recognized one.

WATCH WARD: when an unrecognized creature first actually crosses from outside into the live field in a numbered round, including forced movement or a genuine teleport arrival, it emits a six-elapsed-second ordinary visible outline while inside this field. Occupants already present at creation are not entry events; reentry during the same caster/target/Guards-and-Wards round cannot restart the outline, including through replacement casts. The outline marks actual visible position through this ward's own veil but not through physical walls, and supplies no attack modifier, alignment/identity report or remote alarm to an absent caster. It does not remove a separate actual Invisible condition for unrelated sight-required purposes. A creature may leave and reenter during its original outline interval, resuming only the still-live remainder. No save, damage, Action denial or hard-control claim is supplied by these three layers.

Each constituent keeps one parent cast/rank/owner/DC/deadline. Ordinary dispelling of the addressable Guards and Wards source ends all its remaining layers; no separate three Counterspell windows, charges or concentration records exist. A source explicitly able to bypass/remove one selected magical lock/visual marking can affect only that actual component, without regenerating it through the parent. A removed individual closure ward stays removed for this cast. Local suppression suspends only actual intersecting expressions and clocks continue. Missed entries during suppression never queue a future outline; resumption is not entry. Expiry, concentration ending or actual parent removal ends all surviving layers, without repairing/breaking physical doors or curing other sources. One parcel per caster; a newly formed parcel replaces the old under the normal concentration procedure. There is no permanent secure building, unattended attack engine, free spell repertoire or additional work crew.

NEW exact visibility completion: Watch produces an ordinary visible outline of the occupied silhouette where the observer has a real sight path. This specific marker can supply that position through this parcel's Veil, including when the bearer separately has Invisible, but it does not make the bearer itself seen for a source requiring sight of the actual creature and does not remove Invisible's combat modifiers. Actual total cover hides the outline. Recognition is a fixed cast list, not shared sight or an extra targeting channel. A removed Watch application on one body cannot regenerate during its already-spent family entry interval; future genuinely new eligible entries follow the source-removal scope and live parent. Outside initiative use fixed six-second entry intervals, preserving a spent current interval when initiative begins; do not reset on recast.

completeCurrentCard.status: NEW provisional authored-playtest replacement candidate; not adopted

AC6-PRICE-01.status: NEW AC6 bridge using accepted AC5 pricing order; does not alter AC5.
AC6-PRICE-01.rule: For an ordinary AC6 spell, start from its actual base spell RP price (rank6 generally 13; Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 is 21). Apply accepted Resonance Nexus ordinary -2 spell-price reduction first when genuinely eligible, then mandatory Resonance Dampening Field +2 if applicable, then final Resonance Influence Ease/Strain. A discount never changes generating rank. Resonance Forge cycle 5 RP is protected conversion principal and is not a spell price or subject to these modifiers.

AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.status: NEW per-card dealer/root mapping constrained by accepted Null/damage-root rules.
AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.rule: Forbiddance: caster is dealer at each new field exposure root. Chain Arc: caster is dealer and one shared selection/damage event still creates recipient-specific damage roots using that caster state at root creation. Skybrand: effect has no creature identity; caster is dealer separately for each attack root. Greater Air Pet, Faction Army soldier and Greater Planar Ally are their own creature dealers for their own attacks/auras. Pure damage transfer preserves the original root flag; genuinely new reflected damage follows its source.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.
AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.rule: While the original summon source exists, Greater Air Pet and each Faction Army soldier body count as an active creature and living ally for otherwise legal HP-healing. This grants no natural biology, soul/native origin, resurrection, disease/curse treatment or generic summon healing. A genuine heal above 0 restores the same NullDisabled body without refreshing source duration or command history. Greater Planar Ally uses GA-HEAL-01 instead.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

sourceRefs.role: accepted Lesser Antimagic local intersection and same-family exception
accepted AC5 scoped body-intersection convention; AC6 extension is new

AC6-COMPANION-01.rule: All actual commanded companions/devices of one owner share one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round unless a source explicitly overrides it. Commands occur during the owner regular turn, require actual channel/range/perception/LoE as printed, and execute in the attached phase after the whole owner turn. Extra turns do not reset the ledger. A newly created asset may receive an otherwise available command that round, but creation gives no free attack.

AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01.rule: At each successor hop, freeze the stable candidate array before drawing. Use a fair physical die with equal face mapping when practical; otherwise use an exact uniform N-entry draw. A legal reroll such as Fate Coin replaces that one original selection result against the unchanged candidate array and must use the replacement. Hidden Director-only draws remain hidden; a player who cannot perceive the die/event cannot spend Fate Coin. Once a successor is committed, later immunity, death, movement or lawful removal does not redraw earlier/later committed successors.

AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.status: Current negative interoperability conclusion; no new dispel permission created.
AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.rule: Resonance Seal protection cannot currently be selectively suppressed and then dispelled through the same accepted Lesser Antimagic/Greater Dispel transaction. Accepted Greater Dispel captures immutable termination operations; only the operation targeting the suppressing Antimagic field ignores that same field. Operations targeting Seal/parent at suppressed loci are suppressed and are not rescanned after field removal. Wizard class Dispel is a rank3 spell and is itself suppressed when its application locus is suppressed. An actual future/selective source could change this only through its exact text.

AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.status: NEW scoped Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 classification only.
AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.rule: Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 gateway crossings are both planar transitions and teleportation for predicates that expressly reference either. This is source-specific and does not change accepted AC5 Alignment Portal, which remains planar/extradimensional and non-teleport. Voluntary crossing therefore interacts with No Escape, Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes according to each exact predicate; forced movement remains governed by the exact voluntary/benefit wording.

AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.status: NEW bounded Nexus Conjuration8 benefit; no plane ontology claim.
AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.rule: While the Nexus parent remains live, an aligned creature physically present on the designated destination plane may receive the source-specific temporary +2 Nexus benefit at the events the Nexus procedure states. This does not make that plane intrinsically aligned, identify Wheel cosmology, infer soul/native origin, or grant the bonus after parent ending. Eligibility uses current effective alignment under accepted overlay ordering.

AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.status: NEW Resonance Forge conversion interface using Forge revision02.
AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.rule: After a legal Forge cast, each complete cycle costs exactly 5 actual RP from one capable present participant plus 10 uninterrupted actual active minutes by the required workers and credits up to 60 adjusted manufacturing minutes in the current source work phase. The 5 RP is protected conversion principal, not an ordinary spell price. Interrupted cycles spend RP/time but give no cycle credit. A completed cycle does not independently stabilize an unfinished phase; source phase boundaries control stabilized work. Ordinary reviewed crafting XP/first-success/triviality remain in force.

AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.status: NEW family guard for the two Alignment Nexus modes.
AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.rule: One Alignment Nexus parent application per caster. Divination6 and Conjuration8 are distinct operations of one source identity; successful replacement ends the previous parent after normal commitment. Each event receives at most one Nexus bonus from this spell family even if multiple geometric/plane predicates might otherwise overlap.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.status: NEW AC6 scoped completion chosen for coherence with accepted AC5 same-body paused summons.
AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.rule: Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. The same body, identity, HP, Null state, deadline, carried real cargo and source parent remain; manifestation is suppressed, Speed becomes 0 and it cannot act, command, attack, provide intrinsic attacks/traits or satisfy physical-service permissions from the suppressed source. All real clocks continue. If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. When suppression ends before source ending, the same body resumes at the same legal position/state; no missed action/command is replayed.

AC6-NEXUS-MODES-04.classification: NEW current-authority promotion/clock clarification for Alignment Nexus only
AC6-NEXUS-MODES-04.rule: The full Divination6 and Conjuration8 procedures stored historically in completePriorDraftRecord.modes are promoted into current procedure. Divination6 maximum concentration is60 elapsed seconds; Conjuration8 maximum concentration is600 elapsed seconds. This changes no source/access placement.

AC6-AIR-PET-FALL-04.classification: NEW AC6-specific physical consequence of full suppression
AC6-AIR-PET-FALL-04.rule: When AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01 fully suppresses Greater Air Pet, its intrinsic fly/hover expression is suppressed. If unsupported, ordinary Falling begins under the existing Falling bridge on the same preserved body. NullDisabled0 alone does not suppress Hover.

AC6-CHAIN-GEOMETRY-05.classification: NEW source-specific Chain Arc successor geometry; proposed for joint review, not a global range amendment
rule: Use the actual occupied body volumes in the pre-damage snapshot for every size, including Medium, Large and the caster. A successor is in local range only if one point on the previous body and one point on the candidate body are at most30feet apart AND the straight segment connecting that same pair has actual clear line of effect on the same actual plane. Do not combine the distance of a blocked pair with the line of effect of a different out-of-range pair. Do not mix center measurements for smaller creatures with nearest-body measurements for larger ones.

Include each unvisited qualifying actual creature identity exactly once, including allies, unseen bodies and the caster. Exclude already visited identities, objects, corpses and images. Stable preexisting identity order precedes each fair draw. This is only the successor test: the initial declared target still needs its actual60foot range, caster perception and line of effect.

Bodies have extent. The60foot initial range and five30foot jumps bound their respective targeting gaps, not a universal center-to-center distance to the last body. No arbitrary remote endpoint or unprinted conductive path is added.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_local05PreviousCu.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

AC6-SKYBRAND-ORIGIN-06.classification: Explicit AC6 Skybrand spatial-attack clarification proposed for joint review; no change to damage-root ownership or global condition rules
rule: Skybrand remains a caster-dealt noncreature effect. For its actual melee spell attack, use the blade current attack-origin point for reach, attack line of effect and distance-based attack predicates, including Prone and the within5feet Unconscious/Paralyzed critical-hit rule. This does not relocate the caster body, grant remote senses, create a creature attacker or change the caster-dealer root checkpoint.

Apply current conditions at each separate attack. Against an ordinarily Unconscious target within5feet of the blade, the attack has ordinary advantage and any hit is critical. Multiple advantage sources do not stack. Double only damage dice; ordinary damage at already0HP applies two death failures for a critical when the target uses death saves. Actual Null qualification still uses the caster state at that attack root.

sourceCitations.excerpt: Chapter IV: The Planes Ascendant

After the Sundering the Spiral entered a lull that felt almost like peace, yet every thread knew that calm marked only the prelude to transformation. The Divine Pact, fresh from its ordeal, hummed low beneath the lattice, evaluating every resonance for signs of fracture. Calan’thir drifted along the main corridor, listening with renewed care. Where once two guardians had shared that watch, there now stood seven virtues and a distant inferno that never slept. Harmony and discord remained entwined, but the texture of the Weave had shifted. Possibility began to crystallize into realms that would hold their own gravity and their own ambitions. The first sparks of true differentiation flared at nexus points where the pressure of sealed silence met the stamina of Choir light. Tiny bubbles of substance formed, each carrying a singular inclination. One bubble blazed with relentless heat, another sighed with curling mist, a third shimmered with lucid fragments of dream, a fourth vibrated with questions that chased their own tails. The Weave, curious and confident, granted space for these newborn concentrations to expand. As they grew, Choir members guided their motion, ensuring that no single infant realm consumed its siblings before individuality matured.

During this delicate phase Calan’thir moved as silent shepherd, coaxing resonance into borders that would resist collapse. Pattern drew geometric scaffolds, Balance adjusted densities, Courage braced weak walls with golden light, Sorrow infused compassion so that growth would not devour itself, Law laid protocols that would one day become natural law, Contradiction injected healthy uncertainty, and Transition shaped gateways through which energy could circulate. Slowly the bubbles solidified into vast dominions with breathtaking landscapes still unvisited. At the outer rim Asmodeus felt the newborn realms through the tether that bound his empire of consequence to the Spiral. Though his heart remained focused on endless war, he understood that fresh seats of power meant fresh variables to exploit. He ordered watchers crafted from infernal glass to chart the glow of each budding plane. Their reports confirmed future opportunity, but for now the planes flourished beyond his immediate reach.

The beliefs recorded in this appendix are mortal theology, not objective cosmic history. Priests, scholars, and cults across Aethel have spent millennia reasoning about forces they cannot fully perceive. What follows is what the faithful believe: a creation myth, a pantheon of worshiped faces, and a diagram of the planes — sincerely held, widely taught, and useful for understanding how ordinary people in Aethel think about the divine. Your character may treat this as literal truth. Deeper mysteries of the Spiral and the Crucible may surface only through play; even then, the wider world does not rewrite its temples overnight. Scholars may also speak of the First Choir — seven named virtues (Korvelan, Vaerilune, Delvaran, Shaelara, Xalarex, Thalirion, and Virellian) — as part of the wider Spiral story. That knowledge is not secret, but it is not tavern talk either.

The cosmos of Aethel consists of multiple interconnected planes of existence, each with its own physical and magical laws. These planes are not separate universes but different facets of a single multiverse, all connected through the Weave.

sourceCitations.excerpt: Uncounted eons later, mortal smiths would claim their greatest inspirations came from visions of glowing pillars witnessed in prophetic trance. They would never know they glimpsed the Bastion’s birth cry. At this moment only Choir and Weave observed, etching every dance of magma into cosmic memory. Beyond the Spiral Asmodeus studied the reports of his glass watchers, intrigued by a realm that loved both fury and structure. He whispered to generals in Nessus of future alliances, though none could yet grasp purpose. For now, the Bastion continued to blaze, its song a chord of cleansing heat that strengthened the overall resonance of the seal. Opposite the Bastion’s relentless glare coalesced a realm of hushed twilight known as the Veiled Expanse. It began as single curl of mist that refused to disperse. Instead the mist thickened, layering upon itself until sight and sound folded inward. Where fire sought to strip away impurity, shadow sought to unmake certainty. Rolling banks of fog drifted across obsidian plains that devoured footprints an instant after passage. Islands of faint starlight floated above the haze, each star a memory captured and hidden from prying eyes.

Choir responsibility for this realm fell chiefly to Balance and Sorrow. Balance moderated expansion, preventing the Expanse from siphoning too much luminosity from neighboring regions. Sorrow walked its silent valleys, drawing faint reflections of grief into gentle channels so the realm’s hunger would manifest as contemplation rather than absolute void. Over time the Veiled Expanse became refuge for secrets too fragile for daylight. Within its mists histories slept until ready for retelling. The Old Ones beneath the Spiral felt kinship with that hush, but the Choir’s careful oversight ensured the similarity remained distant. The Expanse honored silence, yet retained structured heartbeat of the Weave. So long as that rhythm persisted, hush could not exploit kinship to rise again. Asmodeus considered the Expanse with cautious respect. Complete erasure of distinction lay counter to his law of consequence. Still, secrets empowered leverage. He assigned subtle devils to learn every eddy of mist, but none returned with clear maps, only half remembered impressions. His desire for dominance grew keener. Between fire and shadow blossomed a realm woven from possibility itself, a place where images held weight and stories stepped forward as living actors. The Radiant Currents formed from the dreamlike bubble mentioned earlier, but when stability settled, the bubble did not crystallize into static land. It instead unfolded into endless archipelagos of light suspended in flowing rivers of prismatic luminescence. Each island lasted only while someone, somewhere, imagined it, then dissolved back into current, giving way to next sequence of inspired creation.
The Veiled Expanse appears as charcoal wash, darkest near the incarceration seal, lightening toward the Spiral path, showing secrecy that surrenders when engaged with honest motion.
The Veiled Expanse

The Veiled Expanse is a darkened reflection of the Material Plane, where light, emotion, and life itself are muted. It overlaps with the Material Plane in places where death, despair, or darkness hold sway, graveyards, battlefields, abandoned ruins, and places of great tragedy.

The geography of the Veiled Expanse roughly mirrors that of the Material Plane, but distorted and decayed. A thriving city in the Material world might appear as a crumbling ruin in the Veiled Expanse, while a humble village might be replaced by an imposing fortress of dark stone.

sourceCitations.excerpt: Of all emergent realms, the one born from roaring conflagration expanded fastest. The Bastion of Flame opened within days of cosmic measure, unfurling molten spires that curved like dragon horns across a sky the color of ember. Seas of liquid metal surged along fault lines, carving trenches that breathed white fire into the air. At the realm’s heart rose the Crucible Citadel, a mountain of incandescent basalt crowned by a corona of living sparks. Every element in this dominion possessed will to burn, not merely to destroy, but to purify anything it touched into brighter version of itself. Calan’thir dispatched Courage and Law to anchor early growth, aware that unbridled purification could scorch the Spiral’s corridor if left unchecked. Courage raised bulwarks where seas threatened to overflow into adjoining aether, and Law engraved runic veins that directed rivers of lava into planned channels. The flame welcomed structure so long as it intensified heat. An accord formed between volcanic fervor and ordered flow, ensuring that raw wrath tempered into forge rather than wildfire.

Uncounted eons later, mortal smiths would claim their greatest inspirations came from visions of glowing pillars witnessed in prophetic trance. They would never know they glimpsed the Bastion’s birth cry. At this moment only Choir and Weave observed, etching every dance of magma into cosmic memory. Beyond the Spiral Asmodeus studied the reports of his glass watchers, intrigued by a realm that loved both fury and structure. He whispered to generals in Nessus of future alliances, though none could yet grasp purpose. For now, the Bastion continued to blaze, its song a chord of cleansing heat that strengthened the overall resonance of the seal. Opposite the Bastion’s relentless glare coalesced a realm of hushed twilight known as the Veiled Expanse. It began as single curl of mist that refused to disperse. Instead the mist thickened, layering upon itself until sight and sound folded inward. Where fire sought to strip away impurity, shadow sought to unmake certainty. Rolling banks of fog drifted across obsidian plains that devoured footprints an instant after passage. Islands of faint starlight floated above the haze, each star a memory captured and hidden from prying eyes.
The Bastion of Flame occupies the first coil, indicated by ruby ink that fades toward amber at its outer edge, symbolizing disciplined passion that may chill into temperance.
The Plane of Fire - A realm of eternal flame, ash, smoke, and molten material

The Elemental Planes are ruled by powerful Elemental Lords who maintain elaborate courts and command vast armies of elemental beings. The politics of these courts are as complex and treacherous as any mortal royal intrigue, with shifting alliances, betrayals, and power struggles.
The Eternal Flame - Governed by the Phoenix Emperor

Dwarven descendants, salamander-like cultures, infernal contractors, free constructs, and trapped craft families can all plausibly exist here. Their politics revolve around fuel, formulas, labor, ownership, and whether the Anvil is sacred, stolen, or merely useful. A community may be lawful without being aligned with Hell and may invoke Brogi as a folk or historical figure rather than objective cosmology.

Pattern and Transition lavished attention upon this fluid dominion. Pattern ensured that even spontaneous visions obeyed underlying harmonic grids, preventing collapse into incoherent noise. Transition nurtured gateways through which finished dreams might drift onward, perhaps to mortal minds not yet formed, perhaps to halls of Dungeon awaiting novel challenge. Courage visited seldom, for courage found little traction in lands that whirled faster than fear could take hold. Sorrow, however, wandered here often, absorbing echoes of hope that sparkled ephemeral before vanishing. Within Radiant Currents, time folded unpredictably. Calan’thir noted that echoes of events not yet occurred sometimes danced on distant ripples. Such flares provided glimpses of futures that may be, though interpretation required wisdom. Choir stored these flickers in Crystal Bastion memory cores for later reflection. To Asmodeus, the Currents represented both bounty and threat. Inspiration could seed ambition, yet malleability defied rigid hierarchy. He temporarily left realm to its motion, marking it as potential recruiting ground for rare demons who could imagine structure rather than simply crave violence.

The fourth great realm matured within a hollow ring of curving lightning that glowed violet white. Inside that ring shimmered vast emptiness where ideas formed entire celestial bodies made from logic, syllogism, and question. Observers likened the space to library without walls where every scroll wrote itself while being read. The Void embraced inquiry that never reached final answer. Each answer, once approached, splintered into new riddles that drifted deeper toward core. This dominion fell under stewardship of Pattern, Law, and Contradiction in equal measure. Pattern archived the evolution of reasoning, Law tracked chains of premise and conclusion, Contradiction prevented stasis by challenging every theorem. Balance supplied occasional anchor, nudging explorers away from obsession. Within centuries of cosmic measure, grand constellations shaped like fractal polyhedral rotated across thought sky, each node a philosophical school debating its own structure. The Weave loved such fertile uncertainty because it produced vibrations that kept hush attentive yet perplexed. Silence found no foothold in questions that multiplied faster than stillness could freeze them. Calan’thir often visited to refresh perspective, listening to philosophers carved of radiant glyphs argue over nature of music, edge, and void.
The Astral Plane

The Astral Plane is a realm of thought and dream, a silver void where distance and time have little meaning. It serves as the medium through which souls travel after death and the pathway between the Material Plane and the Outer Planes.

In the Astral, thought becomes reality, a trained mind can shape the substance of the plane itself. Memories and ideas can take physical form, and ancient thoughts might persist for eons as solid objects or even sentient entities.

sourceCitations.excerpt: Asmodeus dispatched spies to trace logical currents, seeking axioms that might justify conquest for greater good. Some spies returned with paradoxes that unraveled upon inspection, others with insights that strengthened infernal contracts. Thus even the Boundless Void fed the Infernal Conflict indirectly. With four primary dominions established, interplay commenced. Fiery emissaries crossed burning marches into Dream waters, where heat cooled into gem glows that authors in Radiant Currents employed to craft stories about heroic smiths. Shifting mists from the Veiled Expanse rolled onto borders of Boundless Void, cloaking debates in fresh uncertainty and birthing new dialectic branches. Rivers of lucid rainbow from Dream streamed into basalt ravines of Bastion, tempering magma so that crimson glass flowers blossomed along lava banks.

Each exchange required guidance to prevent absorption or unintended fusion. Choir members managed diplomatic corridors called Confluence Straits. Every Strait matched virtue with realm synergy. Balance oversaw Straits between fire and shadow, ensuring one never quenched or consumed the other. Transition supervised Straits joining Dream and Thought, facilitating passage of ideas into narratives and return of narratives as distilled wisdom. Courage patrolled any Strait where destructive volatility spiked, ready to stand unyielding so that conversation did not shift into conquest. The Dungeon, ever mirroring cosmic tide, produced new chambers that reflected these exchanges. Explorers would later discover rooms where magma columns whispered riddles, or fog murals revealed blazing prophecies in negative image. Some levels rewrote themselves nightly following debates in Boundless Void. Through these resonant hallways mortals would one day encounter puzzles designed not merely to challenge might, but to test their ability to integrate opposites without dissipating purpose.

As four pillars matured, tributary realms budded along their borders. Where Bastion heat met Dream flux, realm of Molten Glass Tapestries emerged, landscapes that cooled into intricate murals each dawn then melted by dusk. Along boundary of Veiled Expanse and Dream, realm named Luminous Dusk formed, twilight meadows haunted by memories seeking closure. Between Shadow and Thought coalesced Whispering Archive, an endless shelf of sealed memories that question their own veracity. At confluence of Fire and Thought erupted Calculated Pyre, eternal engine burning problems to reveal numeric ash. Choir welcomed these children, assigning newly formed lesser spirits as custodians. Each spirit carried spark of one virtue, diluted but focused, tasked with maintaining balance inside its small dominion. The Weave expanded administrative lattice to track relationships. Calan’thir rejoiced quietly, seeing proof that Spiral could evolve beyond crisis into creativity.
Planar Connections and Travel
The planes are not entirely separate but connected through various means:

sourceCitations.excerpt: Within Spiral, Calan’thir collapsed to meditative repose, exhausted yet relieved. Choir bore him to apex where they tended fraying strings. Together they mourned loss and celebrated narrow victory. They recognized that edge, once partner, now adversary, still served crucial role by fueling discord far from sealed heart. In dominion of ordered flame, Asmodeus crowned most loyal captains as archdukes. Innorbatos entrenched as warden of frontline, Dispater forged City of Endless Watch, Moloch shaped economy of souls. In Phlegethos Belial and Fierna ruled side by side, twin aspects of precision and indulgence locked in eternal tension that powered furnace sea. Levistus brooded within icy tomb of Stygia, Glasya wove masks in Malbolge, Mephistopheles presided over crumbling palaces of Maladomini, and in Cania Mephistopheles refined magic into blazing intellect. Each domain mirrored facet of Asmodeus doctrine, yet still formed necessary diversity to sharpen law through rivalry. Devils marched in endless drill, honing readiness against demonic tide. Contracts bound them, punishments refined them, ambition tempted them. Though trapped within hierarchy, they believed ascent through service would grant immortality of purpose. Above them all, Asmodeus sat upon Throne of Conflict Eternal, forging grand strategies that fed war just enough to sustain Weave.

Thus the prelude to the Fall set stage with tension rather than cataclysm. The Spiral endured, but each breath felt heavier, each chorus less sure of its next note. The Old Ones in their prison of layered hush sensed rhythm slowing and for a single moment Ul’nak twitched, a ripple that traveled outward until flinthearted wardens of the Dungeon heard it scraping along the memory of stone. The game board lay unchanged, yet every piece throbbed with potential breaking, awaiting the drop of a single choice to tip balance toward descent. In the lowest layers of the Realm Untethered the war between devils and demons expanded into architecture itself. Devils erected bastions of iron will that radiated law like candlepower, redoubling the geometry of Nessus so that every avenue led back to the throne. These ramparts were forged by ranks under Moloch’s whispering Coinfather system, each pact etched on the inner surface of massive coins that functioned as both currency and surveillance. Dispater watched from high towers whose glass facets recorded every flicker of disobedience. Belial’s magistrates rehearsed condemnations on anvils of living brass, while Fierna moved among troops, weaving temptation into discipline so that each legionnaire feared desire almost as much as failure. Mephistopheles’s engineers drafted labyrinths that folded inward, ensuring escape routes were only illusions. Glasya threaded deceit through supply lines so that any resource might prove mirage. Mephistopheles refined war-sorcery beneath glaciers of Cania, forging spells that burned cold. Innorbatos scoured souls at the front, stripping identity until zeal replaced memory.
The Elemental Courts

The Elemental Planes are ruled by powerful Elemental Lords who maintain elaborate courts and command vast armies of elemental beings. The politics of these courts are as complex and treacherous as any mortal royal intrigue, with shifting alliances, betrayals, and power struggles.

sourceCitations.excerpt: Pattern and Transition lavished attention upon this fluid dominion. Pattern ensured that even spontaneous visions obeyed underlying harmonic grids, preventing collapse into incoherent noise. Transition nurtured gateways through which finished dreams might drift onward, perhaps to mortal minds not yet formed, perhaps to halls of Dungeon awaiting novel challenge. Courage visited seldom, for courage found little traction in lands that whirled faster than fear could take hold. Sorrow, however, wandered here often, absorbing echoes of hope that sparkled ephemeral before vanishing. Within Radiant Currents, time folded unpredictably. Calan’thir noted that echoes of events not yet occurred sometimes danced on distant ripples. Such flares provided glimpses of futures that may be, though interpretation required wisdom. Choir stored these flickers in Crystal Bastion memory cores for later reflection. To Asmodeus, the Currents represented both bounty and threat. Inspiration could seed ambition, yet malleability defied rigid hierarchy. He temporarily left realm to its motion, marking it as potential recruiting ground for rare demons who could imagine structure rather than simply crave violence.

The Ethereal serves as a buffer between the Material Plane and the Inner Planes, filled with swirling mists and strange currents of semi-solid ectoplasm. Time and distance work differently here, making it possible to cover great distances quickly if one knows the proper techniques.

sourceCitations.excerpt: Crystalfall archivists have released the Spiral Map in Still Time, a cosmograph that freezes momentary relations among planes for study. In abstract art form the map resembles a nautilus cross section. Each chamber corresponds to one realm.
The Bastion of Flame occupies the first coil, indicated by ruby ink that fades toward amber at its outer edge, symbolizing disciplined passion that may chill into temperance.
The Veiled Expanse appears as charcoal wash, darkest near the incarceration seal, lightening toward the Spiral path, showing secrecy that surrenders when engaged with honest motion.
The Radiant Currents swirl in layered pearl, emphasizing fluid law. Viewers see faint afterimages shift as they step, teaching that dream responds to perspective.
The Boundless Void fills a thin white crescent marked by pinprick glints, representing questions that puncture complacency.

The Citadel of Many Echoes is a small diamond placed between coils two and three, signifying its role as resonance archive bridging shadow and dream. The Nine Hells lie beneath the nautilus shell in a mirrored spiral that turns the opposite direction, a deliberate choice to illustrate lawful ambition forever circling chaos in counter rotation. The Abyss sits beyond that mirror, rendered by blank canvas rather than pigment, a visual silence.

Game masters can present the map during session zero. When players choose a home plane they place a token on the corresponding coil. The beliefs recorded in this appendix are mortal theology, not objective cosmic history. Priests, scholars, and cults across Aethel have spent millennia reasoning about forces they cannot fully perceive. What follows is what the faithful believe: a creation myth, a pantheon of worshiped faces, and a diagram of the planes — sincerely held, widely taught, and useful for understanding how ordinary people in Aethel think about the divine. Your character may treat this as literal truth. Deeper mysteries of the Spiral and the Crucible may surface only through play; even then, the wider world does not rewrite its temples overnight. Scholars may also speak of the First Choir — seven named virtues (Korvelan, Vaerilune, Delvaran, Shaelara, Xalarex, Thalirion, and Virellian) — as part of the wider Spiral story. That knowledge is not secret, but it is not tavern talk either.

sourceCitations.excerpt: The fourth great realm matured within a hollow ring of curving lightning that glowed violet white. Inside that ring shimmered vast emptiness where ideas formed entire celestial bodies made from logic, syllogism, and question. Observers likened the space to library without walls where every scroll wrote itself while being read. The Void embraced inquiry that never reached final answer. Each answer, once approached, splintered into new riddles that drifted deeper toward core. This dominion fell under stewardship of Pattern, Law, and Contradiction in equal measure. Pattern archived the evolution of reasoning, Law tracked chains of premise and conclusion, Contradiction prevented stasis by challenging every theorem. Balance supplied occasional anchor, nudging explorers away from obsession. Within centuries of cosmic measure, grand constellations shaped like fractal polyhedral rotated across thought sky, each node a philosophical school debating its own structure. The Weave loved such fertile uncertainty because it produced vibrations that kept hush attentive yet perplexed. Silence found no foothold in questions that multiplied faster than stillness could freeze them. Calan’thir often visited to refresh perspective, listening to philosophers carved of radiant glyphs argue over nature of music, edge, and void.

Deep beneath Spiral floor in cryptic cavity lined with obsidian petals sleeps Ulnak, the one mind of Old Ones fused after Sundering. For eons slumber remained unbroken, lulled by balanced discord of Choir and Infernal conflict. The refraction introduced subtle lullaby unknown. Threads of mortal grace drifted downward like soft rain. Ul nak did not wake, yet slumber changed cadence. Syllables of forgotten language formed within collective dream, spoken by voices of children who forgave. Those syllables pressed against prison lattice of adamant myth. Seal responded, humming counter tones to keep Ul nak sedated. Calan’thir observed vibration shift. He convened Choir and selected archons. They confirmed energy within melody harmless for now, though amplitude rose steadily.
The Boundless Void fills a thin white crescent marked by pinprick glints, representing questions that puncture complacency.

The Shadow Conclave rarely acts in unison, but when faced with threats to the Veiled Expanse itself, they can combine their considerable powers to devastating effect. Their agents often work in the Material Plane, collecting souls, spreading darkness, or maintaining the balance between life and death.

Something is stirring in the deepest regions of the Veiled Expanse, an ancient entity known only as the Void Sovereign is awakening after eons of dormancy. Its influence is spreading through the plane, corrupting even powerful shadow beings and threatening to extend into the Material Plane through shadow touchpoints.
